prompt: A typography poster design in portrait orientation. The entire background is a flat solid black surface with no texture. All lettering is pure white with crisp clean vector edges. The poster contains exactly five words arranged as five stacked lines that form one compact block centered on the canvas; the block occupies the middle two thirds of the width and leaves wide empty black margins on all four sides. The block is rotated slightly counterclockwise, so every line rises a little toward the right, and neighbouring lines touch or overlap slightly. Line one, at the top, reads "PATIENCE" in very large, heavy, condensed bold sans-serif capital letters. Line two reads "Builds" in large, thick, connected brush-script lettering with a big looping initial capital. Line three is a small solid white rectangular label placed at the center of the block; inside the label the word "WHAT" is set in small bold sans-serif capital letters colored black; three short white dash strokes radiate from the left side of the label and three from the right side. Line four reads "Hurry" in the same thick connected brush script with a big looping initial capital. Line five, at the bottom, reads "BREAKS" in the same heavy condensed bold sans-serif capitals as line one, and it is the tallest line of the poster. The only text in the image is these five words, each appearing once. The image uses only pure white and pure black, flat fills, sharp edges, and a clean empty background.
